title: Grand Admiral Thrawn
description: A red-eyed Chiss, Grand Admiral Thrawn was a brilliant tactician and high-ranking officer in the Imperial Navy during the galactic civil war. He was a proponent of the TIE defender program and engaged a program to manufacture them. He also spent a considerable amount of time hunting down the rebels of The Ghost crew. He was an admirer of fine art from every culture and could discern the motives and battle tactics of a species just by analyzing their art. After his attack on Lothal, he was exiled to a distant galaxy by Ezra Bridger.
